subject: Add trade history import to Portfolio Tracker
description:
Add a trade history import feature to the Portfolio Tracker module. This allows users to import their historical trades (buys/sells with dates, prices, quantities) in addition to current holdings. This enables:
- Detailed breakdown of what was bought and when
- Retroactive analysis of which trades were made with which signals
- P&L tracking per trade
- Timeline view of trade history

Requires:
- New DB table (e.g. portfolio_trades) with columns: ticker, action (buy/sell), shares, price, date, signal/notes
- Migration file
- Parse logic for trade history Excel/CSV format
- UI for importing and viewing trade history
- Update database.ts types
